paper_claim_boundary: Edge-oriented open-vocabulary detector used to produce image-side semantic tags and regions for SPPA. The paper should not claim exhaustive object recognition; it should claim that SPPA can consume compact semantic evidence, normalize approximate labels into hierarchical conservative proxy tags, and render reviewed family proxies or unknown conservative fallback geometry when image-to-3D is brittle or too expensive.
deployment_note: YOLOE-26s was selected over larger open-world models because it is a small real-time YOLO-family model with text-prompted open-vocabulary detection and segmentation. For very small UAV hardware, export to TensorRT/ONNX and benchmark on the target device.
